# GENERATED by scripts/kehillah_library_catalog.py from
# scripts/kehillah_library_catalog.json -- edit the catalog, not this file.
# V49: which other libraries hold a selected work, and planning a Yeshiva
# Visit to one of them. Since 2026-11-08 every library in kehillah_libraries
# counts, landed ones included.

kehillah_lib_holders_work_targum_onkelos = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		clear_variable_list = kehillah_lib_holders
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_holders_work_id value = 1 }
		save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_holder_viewer
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = kehillah_libraries
			limit = {
				NOT = { scope:kehillah_lib_holder_viewer.var:kehillah_own_library ?= this }
				exists = holder
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
			}
			save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_holder_candidate
			scope:kehillah_lib_holder_viewer = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_lib_holders target = scope:kehillah_lib_holder_candidate }
			}
		}
	}
}

kehillah_lib_holders_loaded_work_targum_onkelos = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { has_variable = kehillah_lib_holders_work_id var:kehillah_lib_holders_work_id = 1 }
}

kehillah_lib_journey_work_targum_onkelos = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { target }
	is_shown = { always = yes }

		kehillah_journey_can_plan_trigger = yes
		scope:target = {

			exists = holder
			is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		kehillah_journey_set_plan_effect = { TITLE = scope:target WORK = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
	}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = {
		kehillah_journey_can_plan_trigger = yes
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { this = root.primary_title }
			exists = holder
			is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_sefer_habahir }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		kehillah_journey_set_plan_effect = { TITLE = scope:target WORK = flag:work_sefer_habahir }
	}
}

kehillah_lib_holders_work_sefer_hasidim = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		clear_variable_list = kehillah_lib_holders
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_holders_work_id value = 41 }
		save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_holder_viewer
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = kehillah_libraries
			limit = {
				NOT = { scope:kehillah_lib_holder_viewer.var:kehillah_own_library ?= this }
				exists = holder
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_sefer_hasidim }
			}
			save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_holder_candidate
			scope:kehillah_lib_holder_viewer = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_lib_holders target = scope:kehillah_lib_holder_candidate }
			}
		}
	}
}
